title: Squarespace Lays Off 19% of Employees in Restructuring
excerpt: Website builder and web host Squarespace has announced it is laying off 19% of its workforce as part of a company-wide reorganization.
body_html:
Website builder and web hosting platform Squarespace has announced plans to reduce its workforce by cutting 19% of its employees.

According to the company, the job losses are being implemented as part of a broader organizational restructuring effort. Additional details regarding the restructuring process or the specific business units affected were not disclosed.
